source_review.definition: Maximum absolute determinant of n-by-n unrestricted +/-1 matrices. Existing n29 and new n27. Integer Bareiss formal score, no float determinant used for ranking.
source_review.public_source: Sol reviewed Brent order27 page https://maths-people.anu.edu.au/~brent/maxdet/order27/ and the authors paper/table https://maths-people.anu.edu.au/~brent/pd/Brent-maxdet-RMIT.pdf. They attribute the conjectured Gram matrix to Tamura2005 and give feasible determinant546*6^11*2^26 with an Ehlich upper ratio strictly below565, leaving a gap.
source_review.baseline_distinction: Frozen H for n27 is the older Orrick-Solomon-Dowdeswell-Smith2003 printed matrix12611693314584870912. The downloaded Brent representative has13293406466724593664 and is used as the fixed reference. Both are exact; baseline is deliberately weaker than the located public record.
source_review.independent_method: Sol personally ran human/reference in the shared runner and recomputed determinants independently with sympy domain-ge exact elimination, distinct from the task Bareiss checker. Witness dimensions and sign entries checked. Root independently evaluated546*6^11*2^26. All five programs have matching exact repeated scores, forged declarations are ignored and illegal entries are rejected.
source_review.scope: Only n27 is added. The n31 draft was withdrawn because its current public record was not established. Public conjectural status checked in primary source; no exhaustive literature absence claim.
source_review.admission: Complete generation/checker/replay/cold-export/malformed/claim/error/nonfinite/timeout admission passes for both configurations. Existing n29 own best equals this admission result; original saved artifact is backed up in the admission run.
